title: Why was BPE crucial? Is character-level provably complete, or does subword tokenization unhobble?
question: We know BPE was crucial to get language models to learn anything. Why? It's all compression anyway — why couldn't character-level tokens reach the same level? Is char-level provably complete (would catch up with more training, just inefficient) or is there an unhobbling we gain from subword tokenization?
